item.title: Aloud 1.6.1
item.description: Fixes dictation sometimes recording nothing, especially while Aloud was reading: the microphone now recovers by itself, and if it ever can't hear you, Aloud tells you straight away instead of after you've finished talking. When you stop dictating, reading picks up where it paused.

item.title: Aloud 1.6.0
item.description: A new voice that says 10,000 tech, design and business terms the way people do, and dictation that spells them right. One key does everything: tap right ⌥ to dictate, double-tap it to read, and a small on-screen pill shows what Aloud is doing.

item.title: Aloud 1.5.0
item.description: New Settings window (right-click the menu bar icon → Settings…): pick your own shortcuts, including a double-tap of any modifier key; choose which microphone and speakers Aloud uses; and download or remove the voice and dictation models. Aloud now sends a notification when an update is available.

item.title: Aloud 1.4.0
item.description: Aloud now updates itself, the download is much smaller, and an old Read Aloud copy is cleaned up automatically.
